components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.6rem; min-height: 3rem; padding-inline: 1.4rem; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: "Archivo Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.985); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #1452ed); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-icon { transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover .ds-btn-icon { transform: translateX(3px); } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent, #1452ed); color: var(--accent-ink, #f6f9ff); box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -14px rgb(17 54 214 / 0.75); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #1136d6); box-shadow: 0 14px 30px -14px rgb(17 54 214 / 0.85); }

components.css: .ds-card { max-width: 30rem; font-family: "Archivo Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #082a56); } .ds-card-cover { aspect-ratio: 4/3; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 1.75rem; } .ds-card-cover svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; transition: transform 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-cover svg { transform: scale(1.04); } .ds-card-foot { margin-top: 1.25rem; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1.5rem; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0.5rem 0 0; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 720; font-stretch: 118%; letter-spacing: -0.025em; line-height: 1.375; } .ds-card p { margin: 0.5rem 0 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--ink-muted, #4a6283); } .ds-card p span { width: 1px; height: 0.75rem; background: var(--line-strong, rgb(8 42 86 / 0.28)); } .ds-card .ds-demo { display: inline-flex; margin-top: 0.75rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; border: 1px dashed var(--line-strong, rgb(8 42 86 / 0.28)); border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-well { display: grid; place-items: center; flex-shrink: 0; width: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; margin-top: 0.25rem; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, rgb(8 42 86 / 0.28)); transition: background-color 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-card:hover .ds-well { transform: rotate(45deg); border-color: var(--accent, #1452ed); background: var(--accent, #1452ed); color: var(--accent-ink, #f6f9ff); }

narrative.overview:
Every surface is built from the logo: four rounded capsules, each tilted to the same 33 degree axis, that lock together into an S. The capsule is the system's one shape for anything single-line and interactive, the 33 degree line is its only diagonal, and the logo's cobalt is its only accent. Parts becoming a solution is the brand story, and the hero tells it literally by assembling the mark from its four capsules.

The ground is cool porcelain read in daylight, with logo navy as ink. Cobalt shows up two ways: sparingly as the action color, and boldly as committed fields (the closing call to action and footer band, accent tiles, process panels). Type is one variable grotesk, Archivo, pushed semi-expanded and heavy for display, normal width for reading. Density is moderate and generous with section rhythm; layouts are asymmetric 12-column splits rather than centred stacks. Dark mode follows `prefers-color-scheme` and keeps the same structure on a deep navy night ground.

The build rejects the SaaS template: centred headline over a gradient, three identical feature cards, testimonial carousels, decorative glow, and arbitrary decorative icons.
keyCharacteristics: Full capsules for buttons, inputs, choice pills, tags, and icon wells; 28px panels for containers.
33 degrees is the only diagonal: hero lattice, generative cover art, menu icon, system map connectors, tile wipes.
One accent (cobalt), committed as fields, never sprinkled; cyan lives only inside capsule gradients.
Archivo variable on its width axis: wide and heavy for headings, normal width for text.
Flat surfaces separated by tone and hairlines; the only shadow is the primary button's cobalt lift.
Scroll-coupled motion with a distinct role per section, all of it optional under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Cobalt is the only accent. Where it appears in quantity it is a committed field or tile, not a tint scattered across components.

rules.name: The Gradient Containment Rule
rules.body: Gradients exist only inside capsules (azure and cyan stops on the mark and cover art). No gradient backgrounds, no gradient text.

rules.name: The Width Axis Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from width and weight together: headings expand (112 to 118 percent) and go to 720; text never leaves 100 percent width.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: No uppercase tracked labels. Small headings, legends, and metadata stay sentence case at normal tracking.

rules.name: The Tone Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Containers separate by tone and hairline. Cards and panels carry no shadow.

dos: Do make every single-line interactive element a full capsule (9999px) and every container a 28px panel.
Do keep 33 degrees as the only diagonal, for lines, capsules, icons, and clip-path wipes alike.
Do spend cobalt as a committed field or the single action color, and keep azure and cyan inside capsule gradients.
Do set headings in Archivo at 720 weight, 112 to 118 percent width, -0.03em tracking; keep running text at normal width, 1.0625rem, line-height 1.6.
Do separate sections with the section rhythm (clamp(5rem, 11vw, 9.5rem)) plus a hairline or tonal step.
Do keep content visible without JavaScript and under reduced motion; hero copy enters by CSS, everything scroll-driven belongs to GSAP and is optional.
Do use generative capsule covers for portfolio imagery, and label demonstration concepts with the dashed demo capsule.
donts: Don't build the SaaS template: centred headline over a gradient, three identical feature cards, testimonial carousel.
Don't use glow, gradient backgrounds, or gradient text; gradients belong inside capsules only.
Don't add shadows to cards or panels; the cobalt lift is reserved for the primary button.
Don't introduce uppercase tracked eyebrows or kickers above headings.
Don't use arbitrary decorative icons; icons are functional Phosphor arrows and carets.
Don't alter the logo's shapes; only its monochrome version on cobalt and the dark-mode wordmark color are allowed variations.
Don't use Faint Slate Ink for small text.
